subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should `clawhub-schema` publish and support this registry-export bridge as a stable cross-project contract now, or should the bridge remain unmerged until an approved OpenClaw consumer and ownership model exist?
rationale: The patch is intentionally additive and does not have a mechanical correctness blocker, but accepting a root export defines a durable API and trust-boundary commitment that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor the public bridge contract
options.body: Approve the versioned provenance-only API, then have the contributor rebase the draft and refresh compatibility validation against current main.

options.title: Keep it internal until a consumer lands
options.body: Do not expose a root package API until an approved OpenClaw integration establishes the required consumer, ownership, and upgrade contract.

options.title: Decline this contract shape
options.body: Close the direction if cross-project registry export should use a different integration boundary rather than `clawhub-schema`.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the public bridge contract
recommendation.body: Approve the versioned provenance-only API, then have the contributor rebase the draft and refresh compatibility validation against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent exporter work provides the closest available history signal for reviewing the public export boundary.
